title: The 2027 Blueprint: What Should Punjab Kings Build for the Next Cycle?
dek: What should Punjab Kings build for the next cycle? The latest season's phase-by-phase gaps to the league are the starting point for any blueprint.
excerpt: In 2026, Punjab Kings' biggest edge over the league came in death batting and their biggest gap in death bowling. A blueprint for 2027 should start by closing the gap without giving up the edge.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: In {{ev:bp-yr}}, Punjab Kings' strongest phase relative to the league was {{ev:bp-best}} ({{ev:bp-deathbat}} runs an over); their weakest was {{ev:bp-worst}} ({{ev:bp-deathbowl}}).
Batting relative to the league: powerplay {{ev:bp-ppbat}}, middle {{ev:bp-midbat}}, death {{ev:bp-deathbat}} runs an over.
Bowling relative to the league: powerplay {{ev:bp-ppbowl}}, middle {{ev:bp-midbowl}}, death {{ev:bp-deathbowl}} runs an over (positive = conceded less).

sections.heading: Start From the Gaps
body: A blueprint for the next auction cycle should begin with evidence: where the side gained runs on the league last season and where it lost them.
In {{ev:bp-yr}}, Punjab Kings were strongest relative to the league in {{ev:bp-best}} and weakest in {{ev:bp-worst}}. The chart shows all six phases.

sections.heading: The Six Measures
body: With the bat, PBKS were {{ev:bp-ppbat}} runs an over against the league in the powerplay, {{ev:bp-midbat}} in the middle overs and {{ev:bp-deathbat}} at the death.
With the ball, they were {{ev:bp-ppbowl}}, {{ev:bp-midbowl}} and {{ev:bp-deathbowl}} respectively, where positive means they conceded less than the league.

sections.heading: A Proposed Blueprint
body: Proposal: prioritise the death bowling gap at retention and the auction, protect the players driving death batting, and fill the remaining phases at fair value.

sections.heading: One Season Is a Snapshot
body: A single season's phase gaps carry noise, and squads change at every auction. The blueprint should be checked against the two previous seasons before it drives spending.
The turning-point audit in this series shows which phase historically separated Punjab Kings' best seasons.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Fix Death bowling, Keep Death batting
body: Punjab Kings' next cycle should be built around closing the death bowling gap.
That is where the evidence says the most runs are available.
